name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India

targetCourses: UG Degree (B.Tech, MBBS, B.Com, B.Sc, BA)

categoryScope: All Categories (General / OBC / SC / ST / EWS)
description: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) scholarship for top 20th percentile board exam scorers pursuing regular undergraduate studies.

name: Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS)
description: Covers full tuition fees up to ₹1.25 Lakhs/yr (General) / ₹3 Lakhs/yr (Engineering) plus ₹1 Lakh/yr maintenance allowance for hostel/food.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
description: 50% tuition and exam fee waiver in Govt and Private unaided colleges across Maharashtra for students with family income under ₹8 Lakhs.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Awards ₹2,00,000 across the degree duration for meritorious first-year students, with special preference for girls and differently-abled students.

name: Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE) - INSPIRE Scheme
provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt of India

targetCourses: B.Sc / BS / Int. M.Sc in Pure & Natural Sciences (Maths, Physics, Chem, Bio)

description: Generous fellowship of ₹80,000 annually (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 summer research mentorship grant) for students opting for basic and natural sciences.

name: DAAD & Deutschlandstipendium (Study in Germany)

targetCourses: Public University Bachelors in Germany (STEM / Economics)

description: €300 per month stipend for high-achieving undergraduate students at German public research universities, combining state and private funding.
